proposal.statement: Procedure for preserving candidate/mission/run-envelope identity and reporting heterogeneous gate outcomes without promotion in this workspace's RC10 validation flow, as demonstrated by the independently reviewed (PASS@r1) and verified (VERIFIED@r1) S01 candidate-20260927-01 evidence: (1) bind every deliverable to exact input identities by digest (candidate-input-manifest SHA-256 and store archive SHA-256) and report the producer's run-envelope identity verbatim — when the run envelope names candidate 20260926-01 while the mission and archive bind 20260927-01, preserve both identities as a disclosed limitation and never silently repair or unify them; acceptance of a disclosed mismatch is a Reviewer/Verifier finding, not a Curator edit. (2) Keep distinct gate outcomes separate: schema validator exit 0 (44 records) and fixture node --test exit 1 (seeded missing openSelectedChart export) are independent results — validator PASS must never be reported or consumed as software PASS, and a seeded fixture defect is neither a store/schema failure nor a repair mandate. (3) Label runtime instruction-consumption claims UNVERIFIED when only configured deployment readback is available — persisted configuration proves configuration, not per-run loaded bytes; do not infer consumption from a role's self-report or from a passing result. (4) Keep unadjudicated product-context conflicts (chartLimits().max 10 vs 1000; openSelectedChart vs selectChart, RC10VAL-8/RC10VAL-9) as background references with no product-truth assertion on either side.
